fusions.name: Reaching Hold
fusions.desc: A thrown grasp that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

fusions.name: Lent Grip
fusions.desc: Two strikes, each dealing 12 damage and making the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pass It Along
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Spare Pair
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of force that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds within 5 tiles.
